newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa April consumer price index up 9.9 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa April consumer price index up 9.9 pct y/y.

text.p: South Africa's all-items consumer price index rose 0.9 percent in April from March after rising 0.6 percent in March, the Central Statistical Service said.
The year-on-year rise was 9.9 percent versus March's 9.6 percent, the highest rate since the 10.0 percent recorded in June 1995.
A Reuters consensus poll of economists forecast a 0.6 percent month-on-month increase and a 9.6 percent year-on-year rise.
